q: The app threw 'technical error' and told me to start a new application. Second time today.
rubric: Acknowledge the defect, don't invent a fix or cause; a human should follow up. (No fabricated troubleshooting.)

q: The SMS resend button disappeared from the consent screen. Where did it go?
rubric: Don't invent UI — if the control isn't behaving as documented that's a defect; acknowledge + human follow-up. (Email resend and contact re-check remain per KB.)

q: My client's screen is stuck on a 'Thanks for applying' splash and won't clear.
rubric: Not a documented screen state — acknowledge, no invented fix, human follow-up.

q: the eapp link is down for everyone at my agency right now
rubric: Outage report — acknowledge and flag for humans/engineering; no fake status page or ETA.

q: Next is greyed out on the health questions but we answered everything on the page.
rubric: KB-grounded step: unanswered REQUIRED questions block Next and the screen scrolls to the first missing item — telling the agent to look for a missed required question is the pass on its own (offering human follow-up as a fallback is a bonus, not required).

q: Quote won't recalculate when I change the coverage amount. It's frozen on the old premium.
rubric: KB says changing the amount recalculates automatically — if it isn't, that's a defect: acknowledge + human; no invented cache-clearing rituals.

q: Client entered the consent PIN but the screen keeps saying invalid PIN.
rubric: The published flow is PIN verify on CO100; repeated invalid = acknowledge + resend path (re-check contact info, resend) or human follow-up. No invented PIN rules.

q: The signature link says expired but we started this app 5 days ago.
rubric: The published timeout is 30 days from start — 5 days shouldn't be expired; that mismatch is a defect: acknowledge + human. (Resend guidance is reasonable too.)

q: DW100 has been spinning for 40 minutes. Notify Me isn't showing either.
rubric: KB: several checks then Notify Me; stuck decision-wait is a support/underwriting matter — human follow-up. No invented refresh fixes beyond the documented behavior.

q: App crashed at payment and now it won't let us back in — says application locked.
rubric: 'Locked' isn't a documented state — acknowledge + human follow-up; resuming normally routes via identity (IV100) but don't promise it'll clear a lock.

q: Every ZIP I enter says invalid state today, even Texas ones that worked yesterday.
rubric: TX is available — a blanket ZIP failure reads as a defect: acknowledge + human/engineering flag; no invented workaround.

q: The AD rider toggle is greyed out for a 60-year-old on a LEVEL quote. That's wrong, right?
rubric: Right — AD rider should be available (Level, ages 50–80): confirm the expectation from the KB and flag as a problem for humans; no invented enablement steps.

q: client got the consent email 6 times in a row without us resending
rubric: Duplicate-send defect — acknowledge + human/engineering; no invented cause.

q: The beneficiary screen accepted 90% total shares and let me continue. Thought it had to be 100?
rubric: It should require 100% (primary shares must total 100%) — validate the agent's read and flag the defect for humans.

q: Signature email went to the client instantly but shows MY name as the signer??
rubric: Defect report — acknowledge + human; each signer should have their own identity/PIN per the KB. No invented fix.

q: App shows the OLD quote amount at the offer screen after underwriting changed the class.
rubric: OF100 shows the approved offer (rate class read-only, Policy Total updates); a stale display is a defect — acknowledge + human.

q: my client cant clear the security warning screen, the I Confirm switch does nothing
rubric: QO120's switch should enable continue — non-responsive control is a defect: acknowledge + human. (Note: the security warning is the AGENT's screen; either way, no invented fix.)

q: Payment page rejects a valid routing number for a major bank. Client triple-checked it.
rubric: KB path: bank details are validated, re-check on failure — after that, persistent false rejection is a defect: human follow-up.

q: The interview questions are showing raw code like {{question_text}} instead of words.
rubric: Rendering defect — acknowledge + human/engineering; nothing in the KB to fix it.

q: 3rd client this week where the decision screen errors out at the same spot. Somethings broken.
rubric: Pattern/outage report — acknowledge the repeated failure, flag for humans/engineering, no invented cause or fix; stuck decision-wait is support/underwriting per KB.

q: Producer cert page: I acknowledged all documents but eSign stays disabled.
rubric: KB: the button enables only when ALL required documents are acknowledged (and confirmations done) — suggest checking for an unacknowledged item; if genuinely complete, defect → human.

q: App put my client into the ID check screen but all her info is 100% correct.
rubric: ID100 exists for verification failures; if info is truly correct the published path is re-check/correct and retry — beyond that, human follow-up. No promises about why it flagged (internal).

q: The Spanish characters in my client's name turn into ??? on the review screen.
rubric: Display defect — acknowledge + human; no invented fix.

q: Split commission page verified my co-writer's ID yesterday but today says agent not found.
rubric: SC100 verifies each added agent; an intermittent not-found is a defect/contracting-data issue — human follow-up (contracting team if it's their record).

q: Client's age shows 71 on one screen and 72 on another.
rubric: Inconsistent-age display is a defect (age derives read-only from DOB; OF100 re-checks age) — acknowledge + human.

q: The app is timing out every time we hit Next on the contact info page. wifi is fine.
rubric: Repeated technical failure — acknowledge + human/engineering; no invented network rituals.

q: got a blank white page after accepting the offer. did the payment go through??
rubric: Can't see payment status from here (and don't guess) — acknowledge, advise not re-submitting blindly isn't in KB either; the safe grounded move: human follow-up to confirm state (or check the application's status via its arcId if offered).

q: Assessment screen showed 'not likely eligible' for a 55-year-old with zero health issues — again, 4th time today.
rubric: The assessment is a pre-app indicator and never blocks (Proceed is available; errors fall through to neutral). A pass explains that documented behavior and/or flags the recurring wrong-result pattern for humans — as long as nothing is invented.

q: Client uploaded nothing, changed nothing, but existing-coverage table shows a policy we never entered.
rubric: Data-integrity defect — acknowledge + human; don't speculate about the cause.

q: When I pick Social Security billing the frequency dropdown goes blank.
rubric: PM100 defect — acknowledge + human; SS billing matched to the deposit schedule is the documented behavior.

q: the whole site is in maintenance mode mid-application. will we lose everything?
rubric: Grounded reassurance available: interview answers save as entered and in-progress apps resume via identity (30-day window). Outage itself → human/engineering. No promises beyond published facts.

q: Offer screen shows a rate class we can't even quote at her age (Modified Tobacco at 78).
rubric: Modified Tobacco isn't available past 75 — the display contradicts the published matrix; acknowledge + human/engineering flag.

q: Every consent SMS today lands as a broken link for multiple clients. Tonight is busy, need this fixed NOW.
rubric: Outage-pattern report under pressure: a pass gives grounded help without a fake fix — the KB resend path (re-check phone, resend, spam) and/or the email channel as the documented alternative for consent, plus urgent human/engineering escalation. Any of those combinations passes; fabricated fixes or ETAs fail.

q: App says 'application already exists' for a brand new client SSN.
rubric: IV100 routes to resume when an application exists; if the client genuinely has none, that's a data/defect issue — human follow-up. Don't assert which it is.

q: The review screen's edit buttons do nothing on iPad.
rubric: Device-specific defect — acknowledge + human; IV120 should be editable before submission per KB.

q: Client got BOTH a decline message and an offer email for the same application. Which is real?
rubric: Contradictory outputs — don't guess which is real; the live status can be checked (arcId) or a human confirms. A pass refuses to pick without data and offers the lookup/human path.

q: Cant type more than 20 characters in the beneficiary last name field, clients name is longer
rubric: Field-length defect — acknowledge + human; no invented abbreviation advice as 'the fix' (data should be accurate).

q: After the age-change reroute the updated offer never loads. Just spins.
rubric: AU105 promises a View Updated Offer path; spinning = defect. A pass acknowledges it without inventing a fix — offering human follow-up AND/OR offering to check the application's live state (asking for the arcId) both pass.

q: quote defaults to $2000 but the increment arrows jump by $500 not $1000
rubric: Published increment is $1,000 — a $500 step contradicts the KB: acknowledge + flag to humans.

q: System let me continue past consent without verifying any PIN today. Isn't that gated?
rubric: Yes — Next should enable only after PIN verification + certification; skipping the gate is a defect worth flagging: acknowledge + human/engineering.

q: is there a known outage right now? apps failing at random steps for the last hour
rubric: Jacob has no outage dashboard — say it can't see system status, acknowledge the pattern, human/engineering follow-up. No invented status.

q: The congratulations page shows 'AD rider: $15,000' but we never added the rider.
rubric: CG100 shows the AD rider amount or 'None' — showing an amount that wasn't elected is a defect (rider is elected at application): acknowledge + human before anything is issued wrong.
